Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Account Management team at Bridge is dedicated to the growth, retention, and expansion of key customers. Our Enterprise Account Management team focuses on driving measurable expansion across a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers through deep account knowledge, flawless technical execution and strong cross-functional partnership.
Why Bridge
Join a team that values clear thinking, quantitative rigor, and customer obsession. At Bridge you’ll own meaningful customer outcomes, operate with autonomy, and have the opportunity to shape how we scale revenue across high-potential accounts.

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Bridge you will own a book of existing Enterprise and Strategic accounts and be responsible for deepening relationships, expanding revenue, identifying product gaps and driving product adoption, preventing churn and securing long-term renewals.

Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

As Bridge continues to develop within Stripe’s Money Management organization, you will also drive your customers’ adoption of additional features available through Stripe.

Develop account plans and cross sell into your list of strategic customers, driving growth through expansion and new revenue streams
Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business, deeply understanding problems they are solving and helping drive to solutions
Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship
Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Bridge/Stripe sales culture
Think strategically about opportunities to scale account relationships beyond Bridge product adoption into wider Stripe use-cases
Lead commercial negotiations and renewals to expand and retain customer revenue.
Identify churn signals in your book and implement strategies to prevent revenue losses.
Coordinate with product, success, risk, and operations teams to solve complex customer needs and ensure a great user experience.
Translate customer feedback into actionable product and process improvements to better serve scaled customer segments.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

8+ years of full sales cycle or account management experience focused on existing business accounts; preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
6+ years leading complex sales cycles with Enterprise organizations required
Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products
Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally
Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to close upsell opportunities and manage complex pricing or commercial negotiations.
Superior verbal and written communication skills
Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space
Willingness and ability to work in-office in London at least three days per week.

Previous experience at a high-growth payments, fintech, crypto, or technology company.
Experience with CRM tools, Excel, and basic SQL or a demonstrated comfort with data tools and analysis.
Background in working cross-functionally with product, risk, and operations teams to deliver outcomes for customers.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
As a Sr. Client Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving business results for Pinterest’s largest strategic advertisers. Your expertise throughout the funnel tactics will help you grow and nurture client relationships and guide them from awareness through to conversion and retention.

We’re looking for a Client Account Manager to help our most strategic partners successfully grow their business through Pinterest. You’ll work directly with some of our key advertisers as a trusted consultant to their business. Your strategic advice, analytical skills and sales skills are core to bringing to life the value we deliver as a platform.
In this role, you'll bring that expertise to one of Pinterest's most dynamic and high-growth verticals, Beauty.

Beauty brands on Pinterest operate across the full funnel, from driving mass awareness of new product launches and seasonal collections, to inspiring consideration through tutorials and shade-matching content, to closing the loop with shoppable Pins and conversion-optimized campaigns.

You'll be the strategic backbone for some of the most recognizable beauty and personal care brands in the world, helping them connect with Pinterest's uniquely purchase-minded audience at every stage of the journey.
We invite passionate candidates to join our US Enterprise Sales team, where we have open positions across several business sectors, in various locations. By applying for the Sr. Client Account Manager position, your application will be considered for all available roles that match your skills and experience. Submit your resume once, and it will be considered by multiple hiring teams.

Plan, execute, upsell, and optimize data-driven ad campaigns in collaboration with internal teams.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships, aligning with stakeholder goals across all funnel stages.
Ensure accurate implementation of first-party data and campaign launches with cross-functional teams.
Optimize media campaigns and audience targeting daily using various technologies and platforms.
Deliver weekly campaign performance reporting and insights.
Advise clients on Pinterest ad products, targeting, bidding, creative, and measurement strategies.
Provide exceptional client service through communication, issue resolution, and seamless execution.
Simplify complex processes, upsell and pitch strategic solutions, and continuously improve campaigns.

Proven experience managing and growing client accounts with data-driven strategies.
Strong knowledge of advertising best practices and technical media measurement.
Skilled at identifying client needs, communicating persuasive recommendations, and overcoming objections.
Ability to build and execute full-funnel sales strategies, driving adoption and conversions.
Excellent at managing multiple campaigns, tasks, and timelines simultaneously.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to explore AI tools to improve day-to-day productivity, including campaign setup, performance reporting, client communications, and research. Leverages AI to work more efficiently, whether it's streamlining optimizations, preparing for client meetings, or surfacing insights from campaign data, while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, or related field, or equivalent experience.

This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from our New York office.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Phoenix, AZ; Seattle, WA; Raleigh, NC; Florida or Ohio
About the Department
Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

Senior AEs are positioned to drive in-depth product discussions while communicating and demonstrating value quickly to customers. This role within this segment focuses on both the acquisition of prospective Commercial accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.

The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.

Develop, execute, and maintain your territory plan to exceed quarterly sales targets and annual quota assignment.
Be an expert in three unique sales motions; new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.
Build a robust sales pipeline utilizing the four sourcing funnels: AE led outbound, BDR, Channel, and Marketing Inbound.
Develop and strategically leverage a deep technical understanding of the problems Cloudflare solves in order to drive a consultative sales motion.
Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.
Accurately forecast, build commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.
As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.
Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.
Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.
Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.

5+ years sales experience selling B2B SaaS
Strong B2B discovery skills
Candidates have a point of view of industry trends and able to customize a client centric why change narrative
Track record of beating annual targets of $1M+ and successfully managing complex six figure deals
Experienced in multithreading into the C-suite and across an organization to manage a complex sales cycle
Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit
Bachelor's degree required
Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

Compensation may be adjusted depending on level and work location.
For Washington based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000 - $321,000
This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

About the role Uber Eats is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Account Executive to help grow our Retail business across the United States and Canada.

In this role, you'll play a key part in expanding Uber's retail selection by bringing customers more of the brands they know and love-from nationally recognized retailers and emerging consumer brands to regional favorites and beloved local businesses.

You'll prospect, negotiate, and launch new merchant partnerships across categories including Beauty, Fashion, Electronics, Home, Sporting Goods, and Specialty Retail, helping make Uber the go-to destination for consumers looking to shop on-demand.

You'll own the full sales cycle, building relationships with business owners and executive decision-makers, negotiating commercial agreements, and launching merchants onto the Uber platform.

Success in this role is measured by consistently exceeding sales goals, bringing high-quality merchants onto the platform, and expanding the retail selection that keeps customers coming back to Uber.

What you'll do Own the full sales cycle for prospective retail merchants, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting, and launch.

Build and manage a pipeline of new business opportunities across a diverse portfolio of retail merchants, balancing nationally recognized brands, regional retailers, and high-potential local businesses.

Develop relationships with founders, owners, and executive stakeholders to understand their business objectives and demonstrate how Uber can help drive customer acquisition, incremental sales, and omnichannel growth.

Deliver thoughtful, consultative sales presentations tailored to each merchant's business, clearly communicating the value of partnering with Uber. Negotiate commercial agreements that establish strong, long-term partnerships and create sustainable value for both Uber and our merchant partners.

Partner closely with Operations, Account Management, Marketing, Product, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and successful merchant launches. Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast while consistently achieving or exceeding monthly and quarterly business goals.

Share customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence to help inform Uber's retail growth strategy and identify new partnership opportunities.

Basic qualifications 5+ years of experience in sales, business development, account management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role. 2+ years of experience managing a sales pipeline and consistently delivering against quota. Experience prospecting, negotiating, and closing new business opportunities.

Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Passion for helping businesses grow through innovative technology and commerce solutions. Preferred qualifications Experience selling into retail, ecommerce, SaaS, marketplaces, advertising, logistics, payments, or other commercial technology solutions.

Experience managing consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record of exceeding quota in a performance-based sales role. Strong negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while helping build new go-to-market motions and sales strategies. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously. Coachable, curious, and motivated by building new business.

Mach etwas, worauf du stolz bist. Du möchtest eine gesellschaftlich relevante Marke aufbauen, ihre Geschichte überzeugend erzählen und genau die Menschen dafür gewinnen, die mit Parto wirklich etwas verändern können? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Parto ist die digitale All-in-one-Zahlungslösung für Sozial- und Pflegeeinrichtungen. Wir digitalisieren Bargeld- und Zahlungsprozesse, reduzieren Verwaltungsaufwand und schaffen so mehr Zeit für Menschen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Mission sichtbar zu machen, neue Kund für Parto zu begeistern und unser Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten.
Aufgaben
Als Junior Marketing & Sales Manager*in sorgst du dafür, dass Parto im Markt sichtbar wird, die richtigen Zielgruppen erreicht und aus Aufmerksamkeit konkrete Vertriebschancen entstehen. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen und begleitest potenzielle Kund vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Übergabe in den weiteren Vertriebsprozess.
Marketing & Content
Du planst und betreust unsere Website und Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere LinkedIn.
Du entwickelst einen strukturierten Content-Plan und erstellst relevante, zielgruppengerechte Inhalte.
Du konzipierst, erstellst und versendest Newsletter und Marketingkampagnen.
Prospecting & Neukundenansprache
Du identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen und recherchierst die passenden Ansprechpartner.
Du sprichst potenzielle Kund proaktiv per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn an.
Du führst Cold Calls, qualifizierst erste Bedarfe und vereinbarst Gespräche für unser Sales-Team.
Du entwickelst unterschiedliche Ansprachen und Kampagnen für unsere relevanten Zielgruppen.
CRM & Sales Operations
Du pflegst Kontakte, Aktivitäten und Vertriebschancen sorgfältig in unserem CRM-System.
Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und unterstützt uns bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer CRM-Prozesse.
Du sorgst dafür, dass Leads strukturiert nachverfolgt und zum richtigen Zeitpunkt angesprochen werden.
Events & Networking
Du planst und organisierst Messeauftritte, Networking-Events und die Teilnahme an Anwendertreffen.
Du koordinierst interne Teams, externe Partner und organisatorische Abläufe.
Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache von Teilnehmenden sowie bei der strukturierten Nachbereitung gewonnener Kontakte.
Analyse & Weiterentwicklung
Du trackst die Wirkung unserer Marketing- und Sales-Aktivitäten anhand relevanter KPIs.
Du analysierst Kampagnen, Kanäle und Ansprachen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.
Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst uns, skalierbare Marketing- und Sales-Prozesse für das weitere Wachstum von Parto aufzubauen.
Qualifikation
Du bist eine kommunikations- und vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigenmotivation . Du hast Freude daran, potenzielle Kund für eine relevante Lösung zu begeistern, überzeugende Inhalte zu entwickeln und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst eigene Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung . Gleichzeitig hast du keine Scheu davor, zum Telefon zu greifen, neue Kontakte anzusprechen und aus ersten Gesprächen konkrete Vertriebschancen zu entwickeln.
Must-haves
Erste praktische Erfahrung im Marketing, Sales, Business Development oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – beispielsweise durch Praktika, eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine Juniorposition
Freude an der aktiven Ansprache potenzieller Kund per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn
Bereitschaft, Cold Calls zu führen und erste Gespräche mit Interessent souverän zu gestalten
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und ein sympathisches, verbindliches Auftreten
Freude am Verfassen überzeugender, zielgruppengerechter Texte
Interesse an Social Media, insbesondere LinkedIn, und an moderner B2B-Kommunikation
Sorgfältige und konsequente Arbeitsweise bei der Pflege von Kontakten und Aktivitäten im CRM-System
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und KPI-orientierte Arbeitsweise
Organisationstalent und Freude an der Planung und Umsetzung von Veranstaltungen
Hohe Ownership und Hands-on-Mentalität
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Bereitschaft, Parto bei ausgewählten Veranstaltungen innerhalb Deutschlands zu vertreten
Nice-to-haves
Erste Erfahrung in einem B2B-, SaaS-, FinTech- oder Startup-Umfeld
Erfahrung im telefonischen Vertrieb, Prospecting oder in der Leadgenerierung
Kenntnisse im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Sales-Tools
Erfahrung mit Social Media, Newslettern oder E-Mail-Kampagnen
Kenntnisse in Marketing-, Automatisierungs- oder Analyse-Tools
Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und komplexen Zielgruppen
Gute Englischkenntnisse

Wir arbeiten mit einem der talentiertesten FinTech-Teams Deutschlands daran, eine völlig neue Kategorie von Softwarelösungen für die Sozialwirtschaft aufzubauen. Unterstützt von erfahrenen internationalen Investor verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: weniger Verwaltung, mehr digitale Teilhabe und mehr Zeit für Menschen.
Unsere Kultur ist ambitioniert, empathisch und unterstützend . Wir setzen uns große Ziele, übernehmen Verantwortung und helfen einander dabei, jeden Tag besser zu werden. Bei uns zählen starke Ideen, schnelle Umsetzung und der gemeinsame Erfolg.

The organization is seeking a senior, high-autonomy Enterprise Account Executive to drive sales of cross-border payments and banking infrastructure solutions to global fintechs and enterprise technology companies within the United States. This individual will own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through solution design, closing, and implementation—working closely with internal teams to deliver payment infrastructure that is both technically sound and commercially compelling.

Hunter Mentality: Proactive drive to find and win new business, taking genuine ownership of pipeline generation.
Industry Network: A strong, active US-based network in the fintech, PSP, and payments infrastructure space to generate immediate opportunities.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Regional Director in the Sales and Go-to-Market department.

The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.

· Manage an assigned territory focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities across the UK market within mixed verticals

· Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, and Transformation Teams throughout your sales cycles

· You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

· You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

· You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

· You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

About Agicap
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

s.h: About the Account Executive - SMB role
s.t:

Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.

Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde.

L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie et à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation.

L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs. Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché.

L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d' Ajax Systems . L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur.

Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d' Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication.

Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS. L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre.

La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax. Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships.
Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take.
Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities.
Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results.
Effective Communication: Influence effectively at all levels, creating trust and collaboration within the team.
How You’ll Grow
By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences.
You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases & pioneering advancements in AI.
Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.
As a member of our global sales organisation, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory and develop robust strategies designed to drive demand and revenue.
We foster an environment that encourages big-picture thinking, innovation, and creativity, enabling you to build relationships with multiple decision-makers and articulate the unique value proposition of Qualtrics.
Things You’ll Do
Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts.
Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies.
Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies.
Strategising internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc to create demand and drive senior engagement in accounts.
Gain a thorough understanding of prospects' business issues and industry challenges to craft tailored solutions.
Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients.
Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' offerings and the competitive landscape to provide win-based proposals and pricing strategies.

s.h: What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
s.t:
Significant experience selling SaaS solutions, and experience in discussing strategic business issues at Director and C level in Large Enterprise accounts.
Significant demonstrated success in driving and navigating C-level engagement & connections at the highest level.
Significant experience in leading, planning and closing 7 figure deals.
Significant experience in owning the full commercial capacity of Strategic Accounts.
Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.
Ability to be creative in driving engagement with new contacts within an account.
Fluency in German and English.
You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions relevant to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them.
You can leverage your network in the market to generate interest in Qualtrics solutions.
You have a desire to manage a territory like running your own consultancy.
You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.
You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business.
You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals.
What You Should Know About This Team
Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind.
As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.
The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.
Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.
We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.

s.h: Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits
s.t:
Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing
Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other
At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader.

These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Organizational sales orchestration: Manage the complex sales process inclusive of MEDDPICC, notably the relationships at these clients (Champions, EBs, influencers and others)

Develop tailored account plans for each client and manage the cadence for continuous execution.
Orchestrate internal and external resources including alliances, professional services, product leadership, and GSI’s to craft enterprise transformation roadmaps.
Influence digital strategy at the board and executive level; position commercetools as an innovation partner rather than a vendor.
Close multi-year, multi-solution platform agreements that drive long-term value realization across multiple lines of business, regions, and brands. Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas.
Track, analyze, and report on key account metrics, such as revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and project delivery.

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Language Skills: Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is required , alongside professional proficiency in English.

Experience: 5–10 years of high-tech channel management, alliances, or business development experience (experience at a high-growth startup or SaaS company preferred).

Regional Expertise: Strong, existing channel relationships across key LATAM markets with a proven track record of driving revenue through indirect sales.

Execution Mindset: A strong motor, high intrinsic drive, and the ability to run quickly with little supervision in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.

Relationship & Strategy Skills: Natural relationship-building skills with the ability to formulate a clear partnership execution plan, build consensus, and deliver a consultative sales approach.

Travel: Willingness to travel extensively within the LATAM region to support partners, nurture relationships, and drive business outcomes.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Small businesses are the backbone of any community- and you’ll be the partner that helps them thrive with Square. From the local salon to the personal trainer down the street, we’re looking for someone with a genuine passion for SMBs in the Services space, excited by the opportunity to work alongside business owners and champion their growth.
In this role, you’ll build meaningful partnerships with clients, understanding their unique needs, crafting tailored solutions, and advocating for them within Square. You’ll become a creative problem-solver, finding ways to apply our products to complex business scenarios. As a trusted advisor, you’ll support clients day-to-day while uncovering new growth opportunities and expanding partnerships that fuel their success.
Your day-to-day blends high-energy outreach, consultative conversations, and business coaching, with a focus on helping sellers get the most from Square. You’ll have autonomy to lead your playbook and influence how Square scales in the Services industry, delivering tangible results for your merchants.

Own, retain, and grow a portfolio of SMB Services merchants, helping them thrive through tailored adoption of Square tools.
Drive expansion through product adoption, upselling, and value-based recommendations.
Act as the voice of your merchants within Square, advocating for their needs with empathy and surfacing insights that shape our products.
Balance proactive outreach, retention activities, and growth opportunities through strong organization and time management.
Work with our Sales, Support and Product teams to ensure customers have the best possible experience across all aspects of Square

3+ years experience in Sales, Account Management or related field
Experience discovering and closing sales opportunities and building client relationships.
Experience successfully managing a pipeline to achieve revenue targets
Excellent organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
Passion and knowledge about how new technologies can help better serve small and medium size businesses
A track record of delivering measurable outcomes, driving adoption, and being perceived as a trusted advisor by clients.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts.

You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model. In this role, you will specifically sell into large financial institutions in São Paulo City. The candidate must be based in São Paulo.

This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.
What You Will Be Doing
Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.
Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.
Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.
Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.
Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.
Domain experience: Demonstrated experience selling Observability or Security solutions into enterprise environments.
Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.
Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.
Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.
Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.
Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.
Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a high-energy Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new revenue and expansion within strategic Enterprise accounts.

You’ll be the owner of a defined territory where you’ll build your own pipeline, tell the Elastic Search AI story, and close complex, multi-stakeholder deals in a consumption-based model.

In this role, your focus areas will center on Federal Civilian agencies, specifically targeting the Social Security Administration (SSA) and Federal Financial Regulatory Agencies. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Enterprise segment.
What You Will Be Doing
Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.
Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
Value storytelling & demos: Craft and deliver tailored narratives and live demos that map Elastic’s Search, Observability, and Security capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up-to-date, maintaining ≥90 % forecast accuracy within ±10 %.
Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions—defend your value, structure give/get trades, and land multi-year consumption commitments.
Domain & cloud acumen: Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.
Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

Proven SaaS quota‐carrying success: 5+ years closing complex Enterprise deals, consistently overachieving targets in a consumption-based or usage-model environment.
Demonstrated track record of selling enterprise software into Federal Civilian agencies, specifically the Social Security Administration (SSA) or Federal Financial Regulatory Agencies.
Expert discovery & qualification skills: Demonstrated ability to apply MEDDPICC or equivalent frameworks to drive disciplined pipeline and eliminate low-probability deals.
Compelling value storytellers: Track record of delivering executive-level presentations and demos that tie product capabilities to real dollars saved, revenue gained, or risk mitigated.
Strong negotiation chops: History of landing multi-year, high-ACV contracts while protecting margin and securing executive stakeholder buy-in.
Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.
Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.
Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.
Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.
If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Stripe is investing in the growth of its Issuing and Treasury businesses, which help platforms and businesses embed financial products.

As a Sales Manager of Issuing and Treasury Product Sales, you will lead a high-performing team of product sales executives and be a critical member of the leadership team responsible for growing adoption of Issuing and Treasury across the Americas.

Few roles offer such a direct opportunity to shape the commercial success of a strategic product area while developing the next generation of product sales leaders.

As the Manager, AMER Issuing and Treasury Product Sales, you will recruit, develop, and lead a team of product sales executives responsible for delivering ambitious growth goals across Issuing and Treasury.
You will bring strong sales leadership, operating rigor, and a customer-first mindset to a complex and evolving product area. You will help your team navigate consultative, technical, and cross-functional sales cycles, partnering closely with Core Sales, Product, Solutions Architecture, Risk, Compliance, Partnerships, Finance, Marketing, and Sales Development.
The ideal candidate has demonstrated success managing and developing enterprise sales teams, bringing complex products to market, operating effectively through ambiguity, and building durable sales motions in a high-growth environment.

Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of Issuing and Treasury product sales executives across AMER.
Set a clear strategy and operating plan that delivers against pipeline, bookings, attach rate, adoption, and revenue goals.
Manage day-to-day business operations, including pipeline creation, deal progression, forecasting, performance against targets, and inspection of key sales metrics.
Coach the team to lead consultative, solution-based sales cycles with prospective and existing users, from discovery through close and launch.
Partner closely with Core AEs to identify, prioritize, and execute on the highest-potential Issuing and Treasury opportunities.
Engage directly in the largest and most strategic opportunities, building executive relationships, shaping commercial strategy, and helping the team win.
Develop and refine scalable sales motions for new business, expansion, and strategic account growth across Issuing and Treasury.
Build strong feedback loops with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to surface market needs, unblock critical deals, and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
Translate product capabilities, implementation requirements, and regulatory considerations into clear value propositions for users.
Create structure and focus for GTM initiatives, product launches, campaigns, and enablement programs. Drive execution, measure outcomes, and make timely recommendations for improvement.
Inspire, motivate, and enable individual development, creating clear expectations and meaningful career growth opportunities for direct reports.
Lead with clarity and context, communicating a compelling plan that is aligned with Stripe’s strategy and the broader Global Issuing and Treasury Sales organization.
Continuously improve sales processes, operating mechanisms, and team effectiveness by sharing best practices and testing new approaches.

In this position, you will be responsible for managing relationships with consumer technology and device companies and establishing partnerships to source and recycle lithium-ion batteries.

You will also serve as the commercial point person for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, a consumer-facing collection initiative that places battery drop-off bins at high-traffic community locations. You’ll work with business and technical teams across Redwood, collaborating to solve business problems with multiple stakeholders.

Build, foster and maintain relationships with consumer technology companies and device manufacturers to coordinate multi-level partnerships for the collection and recycling of lithium-ion battery materials. Align multiple locations and global stakeholders when necessary.
Serve as the primary point of contact for consumer technology partnership, managing end-to-end account relationships from initial engagement through long-term partnership execution. Understand each partner’s product lifecycle, sustainability commitments, and battery disposal needs to position Redwood as their preferred recycling partner.
Manage the product qualification process with customers, understanding the technical requirements for consumer device battery recycling, and communicate with key stakeholders internally and externally to manage qualification timelines and customers’ expectations.
Accountable for making sure the business is on track – ensuring a strong mix of consumer technology partnerships, that we’re exceeding customer expectations, and that battery material is procured profitably considering sourcing cost, operating costs, and logistics cost to feed the machine that is producing the most sustainable battery materials in the world.
Recognize customers’ product roadmaps and sustainability programs in detail, aligning our resources to the right programs and priorities, as well as identifying future growth opportunities in the consumer electronics battery sourcing space.
Understand customers’ value chain and the influences of each player in the ecosystem. Direct global resources to manage the value chain appropriately as well as negotiate the various contracts (volume, prices, all other T&Cs) with customers.
Own business development and operational oversight for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, including partner pipeline development, outreach, proposals, contracting, and expansion planning.
Identify, prioritize, and develop relationships with Battery Bin host partners, including retailers, municipalities, universities, nonprofits, and public agencies. Evaluate deployment opportunities and lead the end-to-end launch process from partner qualification through go-live and ongoing account management.
Develop partnership models and partner-facing materials for Battery Bin deployments, including grant-funded, leased, sponsored, or paid service structures, as well as pitch decks, implementation guides, FAQs, and related collateral.
Track and report performance across consumer device partnerships and Battery Bin sites, using data to improve partner targeting, operational efficiency, cost-to-serve, and overall program economics.
Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, logistics, legal, policy, communications, and compliance teams to ensure partnerships and collection programs are compliant, high impact, and operationally sustainable.
Ability to travel 25% when necessary for meetings, tours, site visits, and program launches.

About Wayflyer
Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.
What you'll actually do
You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands on the market. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides.

You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.
What this role could turn into
Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.
Who thrives here
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it.

You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.
We hire for range
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $50K to 500K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure.

Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.
Location and working policy
📍 Dublin or London, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

This is a bilingual Korean field sales opportunity based out of a personal home office. You must live local to your territory on the West coast, or be willing to relocate to the area.

At TheFork we believe that the best things in life happen around the table. As the leading restaurant booking platform in Europe, we connect the broadest community of loyal diners with the world’s favorite restaurants. Powered by innovation and a deep passion for the restaurant industry, we create unique dining experiences across 11 countries.
We’re part of the Tripadvisor Group and proud to be building a diverse, people-first culture where “respect”, “ownership”, “growth” and “better together” values thrive.
If you’re passionate about food, technology, and making a real impact, your seat at the table is ready.
In the UK, we operate in one of the most competitive and fast-paced restaurant markets, where success requires strong execution, resilience, and commercial drive.
We are looking for a Mandarin-speaking Key Account Manager to focus on the Chinese restaurant market across key UK areas.
This is a target-driven new business role, focused on acquiring high-potential independent restaurants, groups, and strategic accounts in the Chinese sector. You will take full ownership of your territory, build a strong self-generated pipeline, and lead negotiations end to end within one of the UK’s most dynamic and influential hospitality communities.
👉 Discover life at TheFork
This is a field-based role (approx. 70% of your time).

Prospecting and acquiring new restaurants, with a strong focus on Chinese and wider Asian restaurants in key UK locations
Generating your own pipeline through cold calls, walk-ins, referrals, networking, and local market mapping
Conducting in-person meetings and product demos to present TheFork’s B2C and B2B value proposition
Managing your own pipeline from first contact to negotiation and closing
Adapting your schedule to restaurant availability, including occasional evening meetings
Sharing market insights with the wider sales team to improve our approach to the Asian restaurant segment

First 60 days
Quick ramp up on the sales pitch and product knowledge (both B2C and B2B)Create a strong pipeline of qualified opportunitiesDemonstrate consistent daily activity across calls, visits, meetings, and follow-upsClose your first 10+ deals independently
After the first 60 days
Reach full productivity on quarterly acquisition targets
Manage your territory independently and proactively
Consistently generate new business through your own pipeline
Deliver strong weekly activity levels, including around 10 meetings per week and 30+ new opportunities created monthly
Become a key internal reference point for the Chinese and wider Asian restaurant segment in your territory

s.h: You must meet these essential qualifications
s.t:
Fluent in Mandarin and English - both spoken and written
4+ years of experience in sales, ideally in B2B, field sales, hospitality tech, food service, or restaurant-related environments
Proven ability to prospect, manage a pipeline, negotiate, and close deals independently
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively
Resilience, with a positive and proactive attitude towards working in a target-driven environment
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast-paced setting
You can impress us with
Previous experience selling to Asian-owned businesses
A strong local network within the Chinese or wider Asian hospitality community
A genuine passion for hospitality, with an interest in digital products and technology.
Energy, consistency, and determination when facing challenges or rejection
A competitive mindset and ambition to exceed targets
Genuine passion for restaurants, food culture, and hospitality
Interest in digital products, restaurant technology, and marketplace platforms
Confidence using digital tools, including Google Workspace; CRM experience is a plus

Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

The Regional Sales Manager (DACH) is responsible for hiring, managing and mentoring a team of Mid-Market level talent to meet and exceed their sales revenue goals. The Mid-Market team focuses on accounts with full-time employee counts of up to 2,000 employees within the DACH region. Our Account Executives are responsible for maintaining high activity standards; daily prospecting, pipeline growth, prospect qualification, and delivering assigned monthly and quarterly sales revenue targets.

Lead a team of 7-8 direct reports covering DACH region
Lead, coach, train, and motivate direct reports through pipeline reviews, managing daily and weekly activities, forecasts and closed deals to ensure achievement of individual and team quotas.
Work closely with your team to achieve both revenue and new logo targets
Learn & demonstrate the ability to showcase the Verkada platform across all product lines
Work cross-functionally to align prioritisation & resources amongst channel, sales, product, marketing, recruiting, engineering, and operations.
Work in a fast-paced environment, pivot as needed and adapt quickly to change, as well as be an influencing factor to the team.
Strategic problem solving, project management, proactively addressing problems and surfacing scalable solutions.
Accurately forecast to sales leadership on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis
Hire, develop, and lead a world-class team to support revenue targets for your team and the company

2-5 years of direct sales management experience
Team-player mentality, hard-working, and the ability to hold others accountable
Strong oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal skills
Experience developing strong internal and external business relationships across different business departments
Proven track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing external candidates
Proven track record of reaching and exceeding goals as a Sales Leader and individual contributor
Demonstrate initiative in helping others achieve their goals (i.e. team promotions)
Knowledge of the full Sales cycle, with demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, and close deals
Bachelor’s degree required
Experience using MEDDPICC methodology is preferred but not required

Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn.

Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig.
Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften.
📍 Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell.

Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen.
Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst.
Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust.
Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen.
Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen.
Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist.
Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind.

Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen.
Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt.
Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften.
Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu.
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen.
Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

· Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag.

· Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

· Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg.

· Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen.

· Verantwortung und Entwicklung im Job: Du übernimmst Ownership für relevante Themen, bringst Ideen aktiv ein und entwickelst dich innerhalb der Rolle sowie perspektivisch im Unternehmen weiter, fachlich oder in Richtung Führung.

· Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards.

Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind.

HubSpot Philosophy and Product We believe the world has changed. We see businesses using more kinds of software, not less, that all needs to work together. To help our customers grow better in this environment, HubSpot is evolving from an “all-in-one” suite into an “all-on-one” platform.

HubSpot is a set of tools that supports a companies customer facing teams including Marketing, Sales and Service helping them to optimize each stage of the buyer’s journey and grow their business. HubSpot ’s flywheel philosophy uses the momentum of happy customers to drive referrals and repeat sales for our customers.

We’ve also invested in an integrations ecosystem that helps customers do more with HubSpot and creates real value for people who adopt our suite of software. What will you get to do in this Mid-Market Account Executive role?

As an Account Executive at HubSpot , you will leverage both inbound and outbound selling strategies to identify and close new business opportunities. You will play a crucial role in helping clients enhance their operations and growth using the HubSpot software.
You employ outbound sales methodologies including prospecting, cold calling, and networking to reach potential clients and build a robust pipeline.
You utilise inbound selling strategies to benefit from inbound leads and collaborate effectively with Business Development Representatives to research prospects and develop targeted outreach strategies.
You deliver compelling online demos of the HubSpot software to showcase its features and successfully communicate the HubSpot value proposition.
You drive the entire sales process from initial contact to closing, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience for new clients.
You target and engage primarily with small and mid-sized businesses, understanding their unique needs and positioning HubSpot solutions for maximum impact.
You maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions in the HubSpot CRM system.
We are actively hiring for a Mid-Market Account Executive; candidates are eligible to be office, flex or remotely located in the UK based on individual preference! Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot : How We're Building a Hybrid Company. What are the responsibilities of a Mid-Market Account Executive? In this role, you will get to:
Quickly identify challenges that our prospective customers face and discover the best inbound marketing solutions for their business
Consistently close new business at or above quota level
Nurture relationships with highly qualified opportunities at mid-sized companies
Build relationships with prospects and internal stakeholders to grow new business
Work collaboratively with HubSpot 's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced
Help shape the future of HubSpot 's mission with your perspectives, ideas, and skills

3-5 years of Closing Sales experience

Fluency in English. Additional African language is a plus
Experience selling to this territory
Unmatched consultative selling and closing skills
Accurate forecasting and pipeline management
Track record of being a high performer (e.g. over quota, President's Club)

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform logistics — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, Co Pallet , introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time, and integrate directly with customer systems.
As logistics providers look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep industry expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company in logistics.
Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of logistics tech.

Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.
Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.
Help transform a huge industry and scale the business toward a $10B+ outcome.
High visibility, direct access to founders, and meaningful influence over ICP strategy and sales motion.

Own full-cycle enterprise sales, from outbound to close, and drive net-new logo acquisition across your region.
Build and maintain a 3x–4x qualified pipeline by running a disciplined outbound motion and self-sourcing at least 30 percent of opportunities.
Lead a consultative, workflow-driven sales process that uncovers operator pain and maps it to Pallet 's use cases.
Advance 5–7 enterprise deals to late stage in your first six months while building champions and executive alignment across COO, CIO, VP Ops, and VP IT stakeholders.
Build CFO-ready business cases and run structured evaluations: discovery, workflow mapping, pilot scoping, and ROI modeling that convert to Pallet .
Document deal patterns, repeatable use cases, and expansion opportunities to inform GTM strategy and drive growth within existing accounts.

Track record of closing six- and seven-figure enterprise deals.
Strong solution-selling and value-mapping skills.
